name: Boobpedia
summary: The sprawling community-maintained encyclopedia indexing thousands of glamour, Pin-Up, Playboy, and adult film performers with trivia and career histories.
ranking_rationale: Enormous depth covering international models often absent from Wikipedia; weighed against mediawiki early-2000s visual theme & aggressive display ads.
